commands.name: aitools

commands.output: aitools bar hidden. Run /aitools to show it.

commands.name: tasks
commands.description: Open or close the Background tasks pane

commands.name: branches
commands.description: Open or close the Branches pane

commands.name: handoff
commands.description: Print a handoff brief for a fresh session and copy it

commands.name: keepwarm
commands.description: Keep the prompt cache warm while you are away (6h bare)
commands.output: Keeping the cache warm for 6h0m more, until 2:53pm. Waiting for the next request. /keepwarm off stops it.

commands.name: askme
commands.description: Ask the questions from the last answer as pop-up choices with a recommendation

tools.name: checklist
tools.description: Shows the person your plan and progress as a checklist above their prompt. Use it only when a system note says progress reporting is on. Send the whole list every call: a short title for the task and each step in plain language (an outcome, never a tool name, file path or code).

tools.name: agent_progress
tools.description: For a subagent listed in the Subagents pane: reports what you are doing and how far along your task is, shown on your line in the pane. Call it when you start, about every quarter of your work, and at 100 when done.

toasts: Handoff brief copied to the clipboard
